posts.title: Pinning Both Ends: Letting AI Rewrite 15k Lines of Test Tooling
posts.description: Tool Y, an old test generator, shrank from about 15,000 lines to about 3,500 in 3.5 working days. Not one old golden file changed, except the ones the upstream specification showed were wrong. The method is the same as in Part 1 : pin both ends, then let the AI rewrite the middle. posts.description: This is how I deleted ~19k lines of code in about a week. A month later: no reverts, no fix-up commits. Why deletion gets skipped Code accumulates, and nobody removes it. posts.description: A question in the dark I went to Perth in early August with my wife and my sister. One night we joined a stargazing tour at Perth Observatory.
